methodology: Deterministic single shocks against public seeded judge cases. Fees and availability are illustrative. Houselights re-optimizes through judgeExperiment; the static LLM replays its saved first-trial lineup; the re-prompted LLM uses a captured tool-free response to the shocked brief. Acts changed counts IDs in the symmetric difference from that arm’s original lineup. Abstention is not a feasible lineup and is not counted as a hard-constraint violation.
note: Houselights has zero proposed-lineup violations by construction: its exact optimizer only returns lineups that satisfy its constraints. This is an engineering property, not independent evidence of better attendance, revenue, or cultural demand.
